headline: China Expands Share Buyback Support and Cuts Relending Rate to 1%
summary: Chinese financial regulators are expanding the use of a dedicated relending facility for share buybacks and stake increases, lowering the relending rate to 1% to further stabilize the stock market.
why: Monetary policy measures aimed at supporting equity valuations and corporate buybacks are designed to bolster investor confidence in domestic capital markets.
why_moved: Lower borrowing costs for stock buybacks provide direct liquidity support to listed companies, encouraging equity purchases.
